company.name: Harborline Freight
company.about: a fictional freight forwarder whose dispatch agent shares one memory with a customs broker's agent on another network

partner_network.name: Kestrel's egress
partner_network.why: 198.51.100.0/24 is a documentation range (RFC 5737): no real machine calls from it, so this machine is outside Kestrel's network until the contract says otherwise

projects.name: Shipment contract
projects.description: Shared memory between Harborline dispatch and Kestrel customs: shipments, holds, documents

projects.name: Harborline internal
projects.description: Harborline only: margins, carrier rates, account notes

agents.name: harborline-dispatch
agents.purpose: books carriers and tracks every shipment; shares what customs needs

agents.name: kestrel-broker
agents.purpose: files customs entries; records holds and missing documents on the shared contract

contract: Shipment HX-4471: 18 pallets of bicycle frames, Busan to Rotterdam, vessel ETA 2026-10-20, consignee Velora Cycles BV.
Shipment HX-4473: 6 crates of espresso machines, Genoa to Felixstowe, ETA 2026-10-17, HS code 8516.71 declared by the shipper.
Shipment HX-4480: 2 containers of solar inverters, Ningbo to Hamburg, ETA 2026-10-24, needs a CE declaration at entry.
Shipment HX-4482: 40 cartons of children's rain jackets, Ho Chi Minh City to Antwerp, ETA 2026-10-22.
internal: Margin on HX-4471 is 11 percent after the Busan surcharge; do not quote it to anyone outside Harborline.
Carrier floor rate Ningbo to Hamburg this month: 1,840 dollars per 40-foot container.
Velora Cycles BV is 45 days late on two invoices; the account is on credit watch.
partner: Customs hold on HX-4471: the commercial invoice lists 18 pallets but the packing list lists 16; Kestrel needs a corrected packing list before 2026-10-19.
HX-4480 entry is ready to file as soon as the CE declaration for the solar inverters arrives; Kestrel has the rest of the documents.

partner.query: Which shipments need a customs document this week?

dispatch.query: Is anything holding shipment HX-4471 at customs?

incident.reason: SEC-2207: Kestrel reports its broker key was in a CI log for 40 minutes; suspend until they confirm
incident.resolved: SEC-2207: Kestrel confirmed the log was private and never shared; key re-enabled

egress_change.reason: NET-318: Kestrel moves its agent back behind its own egress; the contract drops this machine
